changelog: Replace: the 8-state emotion tap grid (never grounded in anything) is replaced by a 9-state taxonomy drawn from Mark Douglas's Trading in the Zone and Fenton-O'Creevy et al. (2011) — settled, impatient, hesitant, chasing, hoping, wanting_out, greedy, invincible, vengeful. Phase-neutral labels (not entry-framed like the old set) so the next release can reuse this grid during a position and at close, not just at entry

Add: tapping a pill's new 'ⓘ' button reveals its full description without selecting it — reading what a state means no longer requires committing to it. Selection is clearable (tap an already-selected pill again, or use the new explicit Clear link) — an unanswered emotion stores null, never a default

Add: includes/emotion_states.php is the single source of truth for these nine codes/labels/descriptions/order — the trade form and ReviewEngineController both read from it, nothing else hardcodes the list

Fix: ReviewEngineController's ruleNegativeStateFrequency() had a hardcoded old-set-only reactive-state list; now includes both the retired codes and their v3.10.0 equivalents so it keeps working on a mix of old and new trades. ruleEmotionOutcome()'s insight text now shows a readable label instead of the raw stored code

Note: existing trades.emotion_tag values from the old 8-state set are NOT rewritten — the sets aren't 1:1 and collapsing them would invent precision never recorded. A legacy lookup renders old codes with a readable '(legacy)' label everywhere a trade's emotion is shown, and the edit form warns before a legacy value would be overwritten by a new selection. Audit query for the existing distribution is in CLAUDE.md — not run in this environment (no live DB credentials here by design)
Process: added a standing rule to CLAUDE.md — an agreed change must be implemented and committed/tagged/pushed/released in the same turn, not left sitting uncommitted
